title: ITSP.10.171 unique user identity and re-authentication need assessed records
remediation: The sponsor identity owner maps unique system users to accounts and processes acting for them. Document the re-authentication triggers and effective policies. Collect sanitized operating or controlled verification evidence that the expected user identity is retained in process attribution and re-authentication occurs on an approved trigger. The sponsor confirms the assessed ITSP.10.171 supplementary boundary and accountable owner.

milestones.title: Collect approved identity mappings and re-authentication settings with redacted verification in the assessed ITSP deployment
